messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx errors detected for ingress gateway in ap-south-1. Error rate 5xx >= 6% over last 3m, latency p95 > 2.1s. Creating incident thread. Paging oncall.
pd-bot: Paging maya (oncall) and raj. Urgency: high. Incident ID: INC-176788
maya (oncall): on it. seeing the alert in the dashboard. starting triage — assigning myself primary. grabbing graphs.
maya (oncall): Quick checks: kinesis->gateway queues look stable. downstream model pods show increased 504s from the gateway only. Could be LB or gateway layer.
liam: I'm watching gateway logs. lots of 502/504 lines with backend connection reset. sample:
```
2026-01-11T05:33:21Z gateway-01 ap-south-1 502 backend_conn_reset service=model-router target=mr-node-7
2026-01-11T05:33:22Z gateway-03 ap-south-1 504 read_timeout service=upstream
```
raj: Confirmed. egress to the model-pool in ap-south-1 shows a flapping host mr-node-7 with increasing TCP retransmits. TCP stats show RTOs.
ops-nora: Are we seeing CPU/GPU pressure on model nodes? metrics show GPUs at 30-40% but high socket errors on mr-node-7.
sre-ryan: Might be network path issue in the AZ. Let's avoid a full region failover unless needed. Can we shift gateway traffic away from mr-node-7 via routing rules (preserve sticky sessions with header bypass)?
maya (oncall): Good call. Rolling route shift: mark mr-node-7 as unhealthy in service discovery, then rebalance.
liam: I'm running the mark-unhealthy command:
```
# mark host unhealthy
curl -X POST https://sd.internal/services/model-pool/instances/mr-node-7/actions/mark_unhealthy -H "Authorization: Bearer $SD_TOKEN"
```
infra-bot: Received API call. mr-node-7 marked Unhealthy. Current healthy instances: 11 -> 10
ops-nora: Rebalance in progress. Gateway connection counts dropping to healthy hosts. Monitoring error rate.
maya (oncall): Error rate dropped from 6.2% to 2.8% over 60s — but p95 latency still slightly elevated ~1.8s. Some customers still report timeouts. CS loop?
cs-amy: I've seen 3 customer tickets for failed embed requests in the last 10m. Tagging impacted customers: enterprise-account-12, dev-saas-qa. I'll notify with mitigation steps and temporary knobs.
raj: We need to ensure warm KV caches for the new backends. If cache cold, latency will remain high for a bit. Suggest bumping cache prefetch for hot prefixes.
sre-ryan: Patching small warmup job now: launching prefix-warmers for top 200 prefixes in ap-south-1.
```
kubectl -n warmup run prefix-warmer --image=internal/warmup:stable --env="PREFIX_LIST=hot_prefixes_ap_south_1" --restart=OnFailure --replicas=2
```

infra-bot: Warmup job accepted. Pods 0/2 -> 2/2 ready.
liam: Also seeing repeated TLS handshake failures from gateway->upstream in logs at ~05:34Z, possibly a cert rotation hit.
maya (oncall): Check certs on mr-node-7 and gateway proxies. Can infra confirm any rotation events in the window 05:30-05:35Z?
infra-bot: Noted: cert-rotation job started at 05:31:12Z in AZ-b. Rotation completed for 10/12 nodes; mr-node-7 shows rotation failure: "timeout writing new cert".
ops-nora: That explains the resets. mr-node-7 likely had partial cert install then started rejecting handshakes.
maya (oncall): Since mr-node-7 is unhealthy, propose two actions: 1) re-run cert rotation on that node with isolation, 2) keep traffic shifted. If rotation fails, cordon & drain the node for rebuild.
raj: I'll attempt rotation re-run with higher timeout and increased ssh concurrency.
```
# re-run cert rotation with longer timeout
ssh admin@mr-node-7 'sudo /opt/infra/cert-rotate --timeout 90s --verbose'
```

raj: Rotation re-run started. logs:
```
[05:36:02] fetching signed cert
[05:36:05] writing cert -> EIO on write -> retry
[05:36:18] write succeeded
[05:36:20] restart proxy -> ok
```
raj: Proxy restarted, TLS handshakes healthy on mr-node-7. Marking healthy in SD.
infra-bot: mr-node-7 marked Healthy. Active instances: 10 -> 11
maya (oncall): Rebalancing traffic back onto mr-node-7 slowly to avoid surge. We'll monitor for regressions. Error rate dipped to 1.2% now.
liam: Confirming logs show normalized connection patterns. p95 latency trending down to 1.2s. No further 502s after rotation completion.
cs-amy: Sending customer update: short-lived ingress errors in ap-south-1 between 05:30-05:37Z. We isolated an issue to a cert rotation on a gateway backend causing transient 5xxs. Traffic rerouted and fixed; customers may have seen timeouts. Apologizing and offering incident follow-up.
maya (oncall): Good. I'll put follow-up actions: (1) add pre-check to cert-rotation job to ensure writes succeed before removing old cert; (2) add circuit-breaker threshold so an instance failing handshake >= 3 times is removed from rotation automatically; (3) postmortem runbook.
sre-ryan: I'll own the runbook edits. Adding automated validation: write-verify + probe handshake on port 443 before marking node rotated.
ops-nora: Also recommend we add a regional fallback policy to shift 20% traffic to us-east within 60s if error rate > 4% for 3m to reduce customer impact, rather than full failover.
maya (oncall): Agreed. Add that to action items. Anyone want to take on paging/handoff for the next shift?
raj: I have to step off in 25m. Happy to hand to liam.
liam: I'll take next oncall for incident progress and coordinate postmortem drafts.
maya (oncall): Handoff noted. Current status: incident mitigated, active monitoring, CS notified. Will close when stable for 30m and incident doc created.
pd-bot: Incident INC-176788 updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Notifying incident channel. Next action owner: liam.
maya (oncall): Quick notes to include in postmortem: impact window 05:30–05:37Z, root cause: partial cert-rotation failure on mr-node-7 leading to TLS handshake failures -> gateway 5xxs. Mitigation: isolate host, reroute traffic, re-run rotation, warm caches. Recommended fix: pre-write verification and circuit-breaker tuning.
cs-amy: I'll follow up with affected customers and include a factual timeline.
liam: I'll start the postmortem doc and ping for reviewers. Great work team. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident thread auto-archived in 90m if no activity."
